title: MED+250 Cloudflare account and deployment-control approval
summary: Owner-ready infrastructure decision for the intended Cloudflare account, canonical production Worker, protected environments, med-250.com route ownership and a non-billable least-privilege deployment credential.

completion_instructions: Create and install the least-privilege MED+250 deployment credential and remove the broad interactive credential from the release path.
Complete and strictly validate the paired account-verification artifact with named verification and least_privilege_confirmed set to true.
Confirm account, Worker, environment, secret, variable, route, custom-domain, approval and rollback ownership.
Confirm the completed account-verification digest and update this artifact if that record changed.
Set every check to passed, set decision to approved, add the named approver, role and timezone-qualified timestamp, and set status to complete.
Validate both completed artifacts strictly and add them to the launch registry only with their exact SHA-256 digests.
